question: What is the descent-of-power view beyond faint-to-intense grades?
premises: This descent-of-power view is declared according to faint, middling, supreme, and intense distinction.
But enough of those mutual divisions, which is the all-round vision of the self nature.
inference: Śaktipāta-view spans faint-to-intense, but mutual divisions yield to self-nature vision.
plain_english: This descent-of-power view is declared according to faint, middling, supreme, and intense distinction — but enough of those mutual divisions, which is the all-round vision of the self nature.
